newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Car bomb kills three in Lagos, press.
newsitem.headline: Car bomb kills three in Lagos, press.

text.p: Three occupants of a Nigerian government car were killed when a bomb planted in the vehicle exploded, local newspapers reported on Friday.
They said the incident happened on Thursday night at Lagos airport and the victims included a security official at the airport and an unidentified lady.
The official was about to drive home when the car exploded, said Thisday newspaper.
It was not clear who planted the bomb, it said.
Politically-troubled Nigeria has witnessed a series of bomb blasts, some on military premises since January.
There have also been a spate of murders of high-profile people, the latest being the killing on Thursday in Ibadan, southwestern Nigeria of a wealthy businesswoman and politician Suliat Adedeji.
